inference: Thirty-three of the thirty-four pinned resources are, as of this observation, still public at their pinned revision, which is also their head, with the license and visibility recorded on 2026-07-31 (or by the pinning source).

mcp-research-alliance/mcp-ecosystem-sample is the only drift: its pinned revision still resolves with the 'other' license that the 07-31 row recorded, while a later head now asserts cc-by-4.0. The hf-boundaries row is accurate about the pin and stale about the head. A card-level license change is a publisher assertion; it does not by itself clear the license, provenance, field-privacy or update-policy review that row requires.

Four hf-boundaries rows recorded no license on 07-31 (Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, AI-Secure/DTap-Bench-Agent-Trajectories, mcp-tools/Z-Image-Turbo). Their current assertions are recorded here for the first time; there is nothing to compare them with.

Every unchanged resource reports a lastModified at or before 2026-07-30, consistent with no commit since the 07-31 review. Repository settings such as gating can change without a commit; this is a single snapshot, not continuous monitoring.

The Yu-and-Ai/kingdom-dark-continent-karma dataset head equals the revision the Space source manifest pins (4ea10623…). The byte identity of its treasure index with AgentTool main rests on the same-day audit, not on this expedition, which downloaded no file.
